63:     fn process_crate(&mut self, crate_hir: hir::Crate) -> Option<NodeIndex> {

66:             crate = crate_hir

75:         let node_idx = self.process_moduledef(module.into());

77:         for impl_hir in hir::Impl::all_in_crate(self.db, crate_hir) {
78:             let impl_ty = impl_hir.self_ty(self.db);
79: 
80:             let impl_ty_hir = if let Some(adt_hir) = impl_ty.as_adt() {
81:                 Some(hir::ModuleDef::Adt(adt_hir))
82:             } else {
83:                 impl_ty.as_builtin().map(hir::ModuleDef::BuiltinType)
84:             };
85: 
86:             let Some(impl_ty_hir) = impl_ty_hir else {
87:                 continue;
88:             };
89: 
90:             let Some(&impl_ty_idx) = self.nodes.get(&impl_ty_hir) else {
91:                 let ty_path = analyzer::display_path(impl_ty_hir, self.db, self.edition);
92:                 tracing::debug!("Could not find node for type {ty_path:?}, skipping impl.");

611:         use hir_ty::TyKind;

613:         match ty.kind(hir_ty::Interner) {
614:             TyKind::Adt(adt_id, substitution) => {

635:                 Self::walk_and_push_substitution(substitution.clone(), db, edition, visit);
636:             }
637:             TyKind::Array(ty, konst) => {
638:                 Self::walk_and_push_ty(ty.clone(), db, edition, visit);
639:                 Self::walk_and_push_ty(konst.data(hir_ty::Interner).ty.clone(), db, edition, visit);
640:             }
641:             TyKind::Slice(ty) => {
642:                 Self::walk_and_push_ty(ty.clone(), db, edition, visit);
643:             }
644:             TyKind::Raw(_mutability, ty) => {
645:                 Self::walk_and_push_ty(ty.clone(), db, edition, visit);
646:             }
647:             TyKind::Ref(_mutability, _lifetime, ty) => {
648:                 Self::walk_and_push_ty(ty.clone(), db, edition, visit);
649:             }
650:             TyKind::OpaqueType(_opaque_ty_id, substitution) => {
651:                 Self::walk_and_push_substitution(substitution.clone(), db, edition, visit);

653:             TyKind::FnDef(_fn_def_id, substitution) => {
654:                 Self::walk_and_push_substitution(substitution.clone(), db, edition, visit);
655:             }
656:             TyKind::Str => {
657:                 let builtin_hir = hir::BuiltinType::str();

660:             TyKind::Never => {

663:             TyKind::Closure(_closure_id, substitution) => {
664:                 Self::walk_and_push_substitution(substitution.clone(), db, edition, visit);
665:             }
666:             TyKind::Coroutine(_coroutine_id, substitution) => {

675:             TyKind::Error => {

680:             }

682:                 Self::walk_and_push_binders(
683:                     dyn_ty.bounds.binders.iter(hir_ty::Interner),

4: 
5: use std::{cmp::Ordering, fmt};
6: 
7: use hir::db::HirDatabase;
8: use ra_ap_hir::{self as hir, HasVisibility as _};
9: use ra_ap_ide::Edition;
10: 
11: #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
12: pub enum ItemVisibility {
13:     Crate,
14:     Module(String),
15:     Private,
16:     Public,
17:     Super,
18: }
19: 
20: impl ItemVisibility {
21:     pub fn new(hir: hir::ModuleDef, db: &dyn HirDatabase, edition: Edition) -> Self {
22:         let visibility = hir.visibility(db);
23: 
24:         let parent_module = match hir.module(db) {
25:             Some(module) => module,
26:             None => return Self::Public,
27:         };
28: 
29:         let grandparent_module = parent_module.parent(db);
30:         let krate_module = parent_module.krate(db).root_module(db);
31: 
32:         match visibility {
33:             hir::Visibility::Module(visibility_module_id, _visibility_explicity) => {
34:                 let visibility_module = hir::Module::from(visibility_module_id);
35:                 if visibility_module == krate_module {
36:                     Self::Crate
37:                 } else if Some(visibility_module) == grandparent_module {
38:                     // For some reason we actually have to match against the grandparent.
39:                     Self::Super
40:                 } else if visibility_module == parent_module {
41:                     // For some reason we actually have to match against the parent.
42:                     Self::Private
43:                 } else {
44:                     let visibility_module_def_hir = hir::ModuleDef::Module(visibility_module);
45:                     let path = visibility_module_def_hir
46:                         .canonical_path(db, edition)
47:                         .unwrap();
48:                     Self::Module(path)
49:                 }
50:             }
51:             hir::Visibility::PubCrate(_) => Self::Crate,
52:             hir::Visibility::Public => Self::Public,
53:         }
54:     }
55: 
56:     fn numerical_order(&self) -> isize {
57:         match self {
58:             ItemVisibility::Public => 0,
59:             ItemVisibility::Crate => 1,
60:             ItemVisibility::Module(_) => 2,
61:             ItemVisibility::Super => 3,
62:             ItemVisibility::Private => 4,
63:         }
64:     }
65: }
66: 
67: impl PartialOrd for ItemVisibility {
68:     fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> {
69:         Some(self.cmp(other))
70:     }
71: }
72: 
73: impl Ord for ItemVisibility {
74:     fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering {
75:         match self.numerical_order().cmp(&other.numerical_order()) {
76:             ord @ Ordering::Less => ord,
77:             ord @ Ordering::Equal => match (self, other) {
78:                 (ItemVisibility::Module(lhs), ItemVisibility::Module(rhs)) => lhs.cmp(rhs),
79:                 _ => ord,
80:             },
81:             ord @ Ordering::Greater => ord,
82:         }
83:     }
84: }
85: 
86: impl fmt::Display for ItemVisibility {
87:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
88:         match self {
89:             ItemVisibility::Crate => write!(f, "pub(crate)"),
90:             ItemVisibility::Module(path) => write!(f, "pub(in crate::{path})"),
91:             ItemVisibility::Private => write!(f, "pub(self)"),
92:             ItemVisibility::Public => write!(f, "pub"),
93:             ItemVisibility::Super => write!(f, "pub(super)"),
94:         }
95:     }
96: }

4: 
5: use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
6: 
7: use hir::db::HirDatabase;
8: use ra_ap_hir::{self as hir};
9: use ra_ap_ide::Edition;
10: 
11: use petgraph::graph::{EdgeIndex, NodeIndex};
12: 
13: use crate::{
14:     analyzer,
15:     graph::{Edge, Graph, Node, Relationship},
16:     item::Item,
17: };
18: 
19: #[allow(unused)]
20: #[derive(Debug, Hash, Eq, PartialEq)]
21: struct Dependency {
22:     source_idx: NodeIndex,
23:     target_hir: hir::ModuleDef,
24: }
25: 
26: #[derive(Debug)]
27: pub struct GraphBuilder<'a> {
28:     db: &'a dyn HirDatabase,
29:     edition: Edition,
30:     krate: hir::Crate,
31:     graph: Graph<Node, Edge>,
32:     nodes: HashMap<hir::ModuleDef, NodeIndex>,
33:     edges: HashMap<(NodeIndex, Relationship, NodeIndex), EdgeIndex>,
34: }
35: 
36: impl<'a> GraphBuilder<'a> {
37:     pub fn new(db: &'a dyn HirDatabase, edition: Edition, krate: hir::Crate) -> Self {
38:         let graph = Graph::default();
39:         let nodes = HashMap::default();
40:         let edges = HashMap::default();
41: 
42:         Self {
43:             db,
44:             edition,
45:             krate,
46:             graph,
47:             nodes,
48:             edges,
49:         }
50:     }
51: 
52:     pub fn build(mut self) -> anyhow::Result<(Graph<Node, Edge>, NodeIndex)> {
53:         let _span = tracing::trace_span!("Scanning project...").entered();
54: 
55:         let node_idx = self
56:             .process_crate(self.krate)
57:             .expect("graph node for crate root module");
58: 
59:         Ok((self.graph, node_idx))
60:     }
61: 
62:     fn process_crate(&mut self, crate_hir: hir::Crate) -> Option<NodeIndex> {
63:         let _span = tracing::trace_span!(
64:             "crate",
65:             crate = crate_hir
66:                 .display_name(self.db)
67:                 .map(|name| name.to_string())
68:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<ANONYMOUS>".to_owned())
69:         )
70:         .entered();
71: 
72:         let module = crate_hir.root_module(self.db);
73: 
74:         let node_idx = self.process_moduledef(module.into());
75: 
76:         for impl_hir in hir::Impl::all_in_crate(self.db, crate_hir) {
77:             let impl_ty = impl_hir.self_ty(self.db);
78: 
79:             let impl_ty_hir = if let Some(adt_hir) = impl_ty.as_adt() {
80:                 Some(hir::ModuleDef::Adt(adt_hir))
81:             } else {
82:                 impl_ty.as_builtin().map(hir::ModuleDef::BuiltinType)
83:             };
84: 
85:             let Some(impl_ty_hir) = impl_ty_hir else {
86:                 continue;
87:             };
88: 
89:             let Some(&impl_ty_idx) = self.nodes.get(&impl_ty_hir) else {
90:                 let ty_path = analyzer::display_path(impl_ty_hir, self.db, self.edition);
91:                 tracing::debug!("Could not find node for type {ty_path:?}, skipping impl.");
92:                 continue;
93:             };
94: 
95:             for impl_item_idx in self.process_impl(impl_hir) {
96:                 self.add_edge(impl_ty_idx, impl_item_idx, Edge::Owns);
97:             }
98:         }
99: 
100:         node_idx
101:     }
102: 
103:     fn process_impl(&mut self, impl_hir: hir::Impl) -> Vec<NodeIndex> {
104:         let _span = tracing::trace_span!("impl").entered();
105: 
106:         impl_hir
107:             .items(self.db)
108:             .into_iter()
109:             .filter_map(|item| {
110:                 let mut dependencies: HashSet<_> = HashSet::default();
111: 
112:                 let mut push_dependencies = |module_def_hir| {
113:                     dependencies.insert(module_def_hir);
114:                 };
115: 
116:                 let item_idx = match item {
117:                     hir::AssocItem::Function(function_hir) => {
118:                         self.process_function(function_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
119:                     }
120:                     hir::AssocItem::Const(const_hir) => {
121:                         self.process_const(const_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
122:                     }
123:                     hir::AssocItem::TypeAlias(type_alias_hir) => {
124:                         self.process_type_alias(type_alias_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
125:                     }
126:                 };
127: 
128:                 if let Some(item_idx) = item_idx {
129:                     self.add_dependencies(item_idx, dependencies.clone());
130:                 }
131: 
132:                 item_idx
133:             })
134:             .collect()
135:     }
136: 
137:     fn process_moduledef(&mut self, module_def_hir: hir::ModuleDef) -> Option<NodeIndex> {
138:         let mut dependencies: HashSet<_> = HashSet::default();
139: 
140:         let mut push_dependencies = |module_def_hir| {
141:             dependencies.insert(module_def_hir);
142:         };
143: 
144:         let node_idx = match module_def_hir {
145:             hir::ModuleDef::Module(module_hir) => {
146:                 self.process_module(module_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
147:             }
148:             hir::ModuleDef::Function(function_hir) => {
149:                 self.process_function(function_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
150:             }
151:             hir::ModuleDef::Adt(adt_hir) => self.process_adt(adt_hir, &mut push_dependencies),
152:             hir::ModuleDef::EnumVariant(variant_hir) => {
153:                 self.process_variant(variant_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
154:             }
155:             hir::ModuleDef::Const(const_hir) => {
156:                 self.process_const(const_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
157:             }
158:             hir::ModuleDef::Static(static_hir) => {
159:                 self.process_static(static_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
160:             }
161:             hir::ModuleDef::Trait(trait_hir) => {
162:                 self.process_trait(trait_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
163:             }
164:             hir::ModuleDef::TypeAlias(type_alias_hir) => {
165:                 self.process_type_alias(type_alias_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
166:             }
167:             hir::ModuleDef::BuiltinType(builtin_type_hir) => {
168:                 self.process_builtin_type(builtin_type_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
169:             }
170:             hir::ModuleDef::Macro(macro_hir) => {
171:                 self.process_macro(macro_hir, &mut push_dependencies)
172:             }
173:         };
174: 
175:         if let Some(node_idx) = node_idx.as_ref() {
176:             self.add_dependencies(*node_idx, dependencies.clone());
177:         }
178: 
179:         node_idx
180:     }
181: 
182:     fn process_module(
183:         &mut self,
184:         module_hir: hir::Module,
185:         dependencies_callback: &mut dyn FnMut(hir::ModuleDef),
186:     ) -> Option<NodeIndex> {
187:         let _span = tracing::trace_span!(
188:             "module",
189:             module = module_hir
190:                 .name(self.db)
191:                 .map(|name| name.display(self.db, Edition::CURRENT).to_string())
192:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<ROOT>".to_owned())
193:         )
194:         .entered();
195: 
196:         let node_idx = self.add_node_if_necessary(module_hir.into());
197: 
198:         if let Some(node_idx) = node_idx {
199:             // Process sub-items:
200:             for declaration in module_hir.declarations(self.db) {
201:                 let Some(declaration_idx) = self.process_moduledef(declaration) else {
202:                     continue;
203:                 };
204: 
205:                 self.add_edge(node_idx, declaration_idx, Edge::Owns);
206:             }
207:         }
208: 
209:         for (_name, scope_hir) in module_hir.scope(self.db, None) {
210:             let hir::ScopeDef::ModuleDef(scope_module_hir) = scope_hir else {
211:                 // Skip everything but module-defs:
212:                 continue;
213:             };
214: 
215:             // Check if definition is a child of `module`:
216:             if scope_module_hir.module(self.db) == Some(module_hir) {
217:                 // Is a child, omit it:
218:                 continue;
219:             }
220: 
221:             dependencies_callback(scope_module_hir);
222:         }
223: 
224:         node_idx
225:     }
226: 
227:     fn process_function(
228:         &mut self,
229:         function_hir: hir::Function,
230:         dependencies_callback: &mut dyn FnMut(hir::ModuleDef),
231:     ) -> Option<NodeIndex> {
232:         let _span = tracing::trace_span!(
233:             "function",
234:             function = function_hir
235:                 .name(self.db)
236:                 .display(self.db, Edition::CURRENT)
237:                 .to_string()
238:         )
239:         .entered();
240: 
241:         let node_idx = self.add_node_if_necessary(hir::ModuleDef::Function(function_hir))?;
242: 
243:         for param in function_hir.params_without_self(self.db) {
244:             Self::walk_and_push_type(
245:                 param.ty().strip_references(),
246:                 self.db,
247:                 self.edition,
248:                 dependencies_callback,
249:             );
250:         }
251: 
252:         for param in function_hir.assoc_fn_params(self.db) {
253:             Self::walk_and_push_type(
254:                 param.ty().strip_references(),
255:                 self.db,
256:                 self.edition,
257:                 dependencies_callback,
258:             );
259:         }
260: 
261:         let return_type = function_hir.ret_type(self.db);
262:         Self::walk_and_push_type(
263:             return_type.strip_references(),
264:             self.db,
265:             self.edition,
266:             dependencies_callback,
267:         );
268: 
269:         Some(node_idx)
270:     }
271: 
272:     fn process_adt(
273:         &mut self,
274:         adt_hir: hir::Adt,
275:         dependencies_callback: &mut dyn FnMut(hir::ModuleDef),
276:     ) -> Option<NodeIndex> {

279:             hir::Adt::Enum(enum_hir) => self.process_enum(enum_hir, dependencies_callback),
280:             hir::Adt::Union(union_hir) => self.process_union(union_hir, dependencies_callback),
281:         }

285:         &mut self,
286:         struct_hir: hir::Struct,

288:     ) -> Option<NodeIndex> {
